             ("Zone_F1_Z01","?")]:
    pass

vals = {}
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    rd = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in rd:
        vals.setdefault(row['timeseries_id'], []).append((row['timestamp'], float(row['value'])))

def mean(ts, day="2018-10-11", h1=8, h2=18):
    sel=[]
    for t,v in vals.get(ts,[]):
        if t.startswith(day):
            hh=int(t[11:13])
            if h1<=hh<=h2:
                sel.append(v)
    sel.sort()
    print(ts, len(sel), sel)
    return sum(sel)/len(sel) if sel else None

per = mean("b3f73bc4-684f-5295-a07e-c26b2b13702c")

print("Perimeter_mid_ZN_3 mean:", per)
print("DataCenter_top_ZN_6 mean:", dc)
print("diff:", per-dc)
